text: …と　うけつけの　ねーちゃんが　いっとった　しんせつやのう

structure.jp: …と　うけつけの　ねーちゃんが　いっとった
structure.en: ...is what the young lady at reception said

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と comes right after someone's words and hands them to 'said'; here the words are the line just before. …と いっとった = '...is what she said'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とった is a dialect and old-man short form of ていた. いっとった = 'was saying'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the western-dialect way of saying だ, 'it is', and のう is an old man's 'isn't it'. しんせつやのう = 'that's kind, isn't it'.
